'''Ovidius''' is a male NPC telling horror story to children in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. <!--In the same location, a [[Aero Predator]] may appear at night. -->

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Ovidius''': They say during rainy nights, you can hear something whimpering in the Old District... The sounds of a bird, a lion. Even slithering across your body quietly like a snake...
:'''Ovidius''': A man was so curious that he decided to walk into the water to find out what it was.
:'''Ovidius''': He slowly walked into the lake to get a better look. And then...
:{{DIcon}} And then?
:'''Ovidius''': And then... he saw a strange creature. The combination of a lion and a snake, but it also had the wings of a bird. The moment the creature and the man met eye to eye, it pounced towards him!
:'''Ovidius''': The man ran with all his might, yet he was nowhere near the edge of the lake. That was when he realized that he had stepped into a darkened sea...
{{Dialogue End}}
